feature: Guarded purge of seven non-project production records
route: Production PM database, AI/RAG database, and Supabase Storage

flows.name: Exact-target dry run
steps: Resolve every manifest target by exact name and internal ID
Validate job and Acumatica identifiers where present
Inventory app, RAG, indirect document, and storage dependencies
Run the complete deletion sequence and roll it back
flows.expectedOutcome: All seven targets resolve uniquely and the full rollback rehearsal leaves no scoped non-audit reference

flows.name: Confirmed production purge
steps: Delete RAG content and clear retained cost-ledger attribution
Delete app content and the seven project rows
Run committed readback and a separate deleted-state verifier
flows.expectedOutcome: No active project, non-audit app reference, RAG project/document reference, or exact project-folder object remains

claims.description: The destructive operation is bound to the exact seven intended records and rejects changed or ambiguous targets
The seven projects and their non-audit app and RAG data were deleted with zero scoped residue
Wrong confirmation, target mismatch, dependency failure, and remaining-row checks stop the operation loudly
Historical audit tombstones and anonymized cost-ledger entries remain without an active project
